description: District Secretary - Galle - The Annual Esala Festival - 2023 of Historic Welle, Dewalaya, Habaraduwa D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the dates for the Annual Esala Festival at a specific religious site (Welle Dewalaya). The content deals with cultural/religious event scheduling under the Pilgrimages Ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). As a cultural/religious announcement not covered by other categories, it falls under Miscellaneous.
